answer.rationale: The incumbent will not deliver the required cost reduction, while the 14-day expiry and 94% utilization make an immediate full primary-vendor switch hazardous. Verify the low-cost vendor's onboarding and invoicing record, alongside the proven resilience benefit of dual sourcing. Add the second source through a guarded allocation or pilot, preserving incumbent continuity while testing whether the lower-cost source can reduce total cost without disrupting deliveries. The 18% savings target and the new supplier's delivery capability remain uncertain.
